svg.title: Three side-by-side BB830 breadboards with chip placement and grouped connections
svg.desc: Memory, Core, and Peripheral breadboards share aligned row numbers. Colored lines show grouped package-level signal relationships; power and ground are omitted.
svg.text: BB830 physical placement and grouped chip connections
Boards are side by side with long edges parallel; equal terminal-row numbers align laterally
Pico to GAL: RESET# (also tapped by Z80), PICO_CE#, PICO_OE#, PICO_WE#
One line represents a signal group. Blue paths are shared trunks; intermediate chips are taps, not series logic.
Power, ground, pull resistors, and decoupling are intentionally omitted.
DIP widths show pin-row span; Pico shows its 0.7in header span (PCB body approximately 0.83in wide).
